documentation.title: Introduction to Firebase Local Emulator Suite
Install, configure and integrate Local Emulator Suite

baseline.upgradePolicy: Bumping the pin in conformance/package.json and re-recording turns every newly detected difference into a debt row in conformance/DEBT.md, because a row can only become a documented divergence once a human writes it into conformance/divergences.json. Any surface the new baseline adds is absent from this contract, so compat-check fails until it is enumerated with a scope; until then the claim sentence names the old version and is therefore false, which is the intended fail-closed behaviour.

claim.sentence: fireemu is compatible with the listed Local Emulator Suite products as shipped by firebase-tools 15.28.2 -- Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication, Cloud Storage for Firebase and Cloud Functions, with Security Rules on the Firestore and Storage surfaces -- under the `firebase` compatibility profile and the evidence recorded in `spec/compatibility/contract.json`; it makes no complete-suite and no unqualified superset claim while Realtime Database, Firebase Hosting and App Hosting are deferred, Firebase Extensions is not planned, and the Emulator UI, the Emulator Hub, Logging, Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Tasks and Data Connect remain open gaps.
claim.rule: The claim is version-qualified and product-enumerated. It may not be widened to a complete-suite or unqualified superset claim while any surface in this contract has scope deferred or not-planned.

firebase.intent: Reproduce the behaviour the pinned Local Emulator Suite ships and Firebase documents, including its documented limitations. fireemu may not add a rejection in this profile: extra strictness belongs to the strict profile.

officialEmulatorDivergences.note: firebase reproduces the Firebase backend, which refuses a query whose composite index is not configured. The pinned official Firestore emulator does not check indexes at all, so a run that must reproduce the emulator rather than the backend sets emulator instead. Both values are official behaviour of a different oracle; conservative is not.

strict.intent: Add fireemu's stricter validation on top of the firebase profile. Every key here may only refuse more than the official emulator, never less, and every refusal it adds must be published as a capability precision or a documented divergence.

profileStatus: The two profiles are declared key sets, applied by writing the keys into a fireemu configuration file. There is no single runtime switch that applies them yet: the canonical schema's top-level profile key (deterministic / compat / chaos / conformance) is accepted and not yet interpreted. tools/compat-check checks every key and value a profile names against spec/config/fireemu.schema.json so the sets cannot drift from the configuration surface.

scopes.active: In the supported-surface milestone. Either parity is claimed with evidence, the surface is a fireemu addition, or it is an open gap that blocks the complete-suite claim.
scopes.deferred: In the pinned baseline, deliberately not implemented for now. Blocks any complete-suite or unqualified superset claim.
scopes.not-planned: In the pinned baseline, deliberately never implemented. Blocks any complete-suite claim against this baseline.

states.claimed: parity is claimed against the pinned official emulator, with executed evidence
states.addition: a fireemu surface with no official counterpart; never described as parity
states.gap: an active surface with no parity claim yet

sharedTerms.qualifier: validation-only: a well-formed pipeline is answered UNIMPLEMENTED FS_PIPE_VALIDATION_ONLY
Storage object finalized / deleted / metadataUpdated events reach v1 and v2 handlers
limitedUse: true fails closed with 501 APP_CHECK_REPLAY_UNSUPPORTED

surfaces.title: Cloud Firestore
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface. Parity is claimed for the gRPC service, the REST API, the WebChannel transport and Security Rules, against the pinned official emulator.
gaps: import and export of the official Firestore emulator artifacts
PartitionQuery is served but not recorded in a conformance fixture

claims.statement: The Firestore v1 gRPC service serves documents, atomic commits, serializable transactions, queries, aggregations and the Write and Listen streams against local state, with the same status codes and error shapes as the pinned official emulator.
officialLimitations: the official Firestore emulator holds every database in memory and loses it on exit unless the run exports it, so no fixture may assume durable state
the official Firestore emulator enforces none of the production document, transaction or index limits, so the firebase profile must not reject a request the official emulator admits

fireemuOnly.behaviour: a one-hour read_time retention window with exact resume replay recomputed from retained MVCC history, and an ExistenceFilter carrying the exact count rather than a bloom filter
seeded fault injection on firestore.commit / read / beginTransaction

productionOnly: real index build latency and backfill

claims.statement: The Firestore REST API is served on the Firestore port next to gRPC and reproduces the official emulator's Google JSON error envelopes, including the firestore/lite transport.
officialLimitations: the official emulator refuses readTime selectors and findNearest on the REST surface rather than answering them

claims.statement: The browser web SDK's WebChannel v8 transport is served on the Firestore port, and a target refused on its own merits is removed without closing the channel.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: a target removed with its own cause (a missing composite index, a malformed query, a Rules denial) while the channel keeps serving its other targets

claims.statement: Composite index validation is a declared policy, not a hidden default: the emulator value reproduces the pinned official emulator, which serves a query whose composite index is not configured.
officialLimitations: the official Firestore emulator never checks composite indexes and serves the query as if the index existed; firestore.indexValidationPolicy = emulator is the value that reproduces it, and the FS_EMULATOR_INDEX_ASSUMED warning is fireemu-only

fireemuOnly.behaviour: firestore.indexValidationPolicy = conservative rejects a query whose composite index is not configured and prints the firestore.indexes.json fragment production would need

claims.statement: Production Firestore limits are versioned catalog entries with a disposition, so a limit violation is reported locally instead of surfacing only in production.
officialLimitations: the official emulator enforces no production limit at all, so every limit disposition is off in the firebase profile

fireemuOnly.behaviour: boundary-exact limit catalogs with a per-limit disposition and warning thresholds

productionOnly: quota, throughput and per-project rate limits

claims.statement: Security Rules are evaluated natively on every Firestore surface: reads against the returned snapshot, writes inside the commit, and queries proven from their constraints.
officialLimitations: the official emulator renders request.query.orderBy as "field ASC, other DESC"; production's rendering is undocumented, so the emulator form is the one reproduced

fireemuOnly.behaviour: query proofs are sound but not complete: a rule that reads an unconstrained field denies the query rather than admitting it
static rules linting and runtime expression / document-access budgets

claims.statement: ExecutePipeline is decoded, identified and validated against the documented stage registry; a well-formed pipeline is answered UNIMPLEMENTED FS_PIPE_VALIDATION_ONLY rather than executed, and an unknown stage is refused rather than skipped.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: strict decode-and-validate with a canonical form in the refusal

preview: ExecutePipeline / StructuredPipeline is a preview Firestore surface; the pinned official emulator does not serve it either, so there is no oracle for its execution semantics

claims.statement: Firestore Enterprise text index definitions are validated at start and through the control API; the backfill lifecycle and local search are not served.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: duplicate index shapes are warned and unknown or output-only fields refused

preview: Firestore Enterprise edition and its text search surface are preview; the pinned official emulator ships no equivalent, so this claim is scoped to definition validation only

surfaces.title: Firebase Authentication
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface. Parity is claimed for the Identity Toolkit subset the official emulator serves, including multi-factor enrolment and sign-in.
gaps: import and export of the official Auth emulator account files

claims.statement: The Identity Toolkit REST subset the Auth emulator serves is reproduced, including the emulator-only routes that read out-of-band codes and verification codes.
officialLimitations: the official Auth emulator mails and texts nothing: codes are read from /emulator/v1/projects/{p}/oobCodes and verificationCodes
the official Auth emulator accepts reCAPTCHA tokens unchecked
the official Auth emulator performs no OAuth round trip: accounts:signInWithIdp trusts the assertion in postBody

fireemuOnly.behaviour: codes are deterministic from the session seed rather than random

productionOnly: real identity provider round trips and provider-side account state

claims.statement: ID tokens are issued in the unsigned Firebase Auth Emulator format by default and are accepted only by the project of their audience.
officialLimitations: the Firebase Admin SDK accepts only alg none while FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST is set, so the firebase profile must sign with auth.idTokenSigning = unsigned-emulator

fireemuOnly.behaviour: auth.idTokenSigning = session-rsa issues RS256 tokens from a seed-derived key and publishes a JWKS, so every surface refuses unsigned or foreign-signed tokens

claims.statement: TOTP and SMS second factors are enrolled, signed in with and withdrawn through the Identity Platform routes the official emulator serves.
officialLimitations: the official emulator sends no SMS: phone codes come from the emulator verificationCodes route

fireemuOnly.behaviour: the TOTP acceptance window and the enrolment session TTL are local policies driven by the virtual clock

surfaces.title: Cloud Storage for Firebase
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface. Parity is claimed for both dialects and for Storage Security Rules.
gaps: import and export of the official Storage emulator artifacts

claims.statement: Both storage dialects the official emulator serves are reproduced: the Firebase protocol with resumable uploads and download tokens, and the JSON API with generation and metageneration preconditions, prefix / delimiter listing and range reads.
officialLimitations: the official Storage emulator implements no object versioning, no ACLs, no signed URLs, no compose and no notifications

fireemuOnly.behaviour: a 256 MiB object cap, a 260 MiB body cap and a process-wide 1 GiB buffered-body budget answered with 503 and Retry-After

productionOnly: ACLs, signed URLs, object lifecycle management and Pub/Sub notifications

claims.statement: Storage Security Rules are evaluated on the Firebase dialect, at upload finalization against the received bytes, with firestore.get() and firestore.exists() available.
officialLimitations: the official emulator treats the JSON API as a privileged surface: it goes around Security Rules unless an end-user token is presented
list requires rules_version 2 in the official rules runtime

surfaces.title: Cloud Functions for Firebase
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface. Parity is claimed for HTTPS and callable functions, event triggers and scheduled functions running a real firebase-functions codebase in the bundled Node runner.

claims.statement: onRequest, onCall (v2) and v1 HTTPS functions run in the bundled Node runner behind /{project}/{region}/{function} and reproduce the official callable envelope, including every HttpsError code and the auth context of the caller.
officialLimitations: the official Functions emulator runs the runtime with token verification skipped, so any App Check field becomes an app with a null id and Bearer owner becomes an authenticated context with a null uid

fireemuOnly.behaviour: the daemon proxy refuses Bearer owner, forged bearer values and duplicate or folded auth fields as callable user identities instead of admitting them

claims.statement: Firestore document, Storage object, Pub/Sub topic and Auth user events are delivered to v1 and v2 handlers as JSON CloudEvents, with retries, dead letters and bounded diagnostic retention.
officialLimitations: the official emulator consumes JSON CloudEvents in the Node runtime; the protobuf payload form is not what firebase-functions reads

fireemuOnly.behaviour: retries run on virtual-time backoff and awaitIdle replaces sleeping, and duplicate delivery is a seeded fault rather than an accident

claims.statement: onSchedule functions run against the virtual clock with cron and App Engine schedules, IANA time zones, a catch-up policy and an overlap policy.
officialLimitations: the official emulator does not run scheduled functions on a schedule at all: it exposes them for manual invocation

fireemuOnly.behaviour: scheduled runs are driven by the virtual clock, with scheduler.catchUp and scheduler.overlap deciding what a clock jump produces

surfaces.title: Firebase App Check
surfaces.decision: A fireemu addition, not an official emulator: the pinned Local Emulator Suite ships no App Check surface at all. It is claimed on its own terms and can never be described as parity.
notes: the official emulators are the oracle for what they do not do: every enforced-denial row that would need a real project is recorded pending in conformance/DEBT.md

claims.statement: A local App Check issuer exchanges registered debug secrets for instance-signed RS256 tokens and publishes its public key at a JWKS route.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: the whole App Check surface: the official Local Emulator Suite ships no exchange endpoint, no JWKS route and no App Check verification, so this is an addition rather than parity
the private fireemu_epoch claim makes a local token deliberately non-portable across daemon instances

productionOnly: Play Integrity, App Attest, DeviceCheck and reCAPTCHA attestation, which prove device integrity and cannot be emulated

claims.statement: One transport-neutral admission decision governs off, unenforced and enforced modes for Auth, Firestore and Storage, and callable Functions enforcement is per function.
officialLimitations: the official emulators inspect X-Firebase-AppCheck on no product, so there is no oracle for an enforced denial and every such conformance row is recorded pending with the reason "needs a real project"

fireemuOnly.behaviour: an unverifiable or duplicated X-Firebase-AppCheck field is refused where the official Functions emulator admits it

productionOnly: the exact wire messages a real project returns under enforcement

claims.statement: Every classified request is recorded as a secret-free observation in a bounded per-project ring with cumulative counters, readable through the control API and the Emulator UI page.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: the observation surface has no official counterpart at all

claims.statement: The real firebase Web SDK obtains a local App Check token through initializeAppCheck with a CustomProvider and sends it to Firestore, Storage, Auth and a callable.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: @firebase/app-check hard-codes the production base URL, so the documented provider dials the local exchange itself

productionOnly: the Android, Apple and Flutter App Check SDKs, which are not exercised

claims.statement: Replay protection and production attestation providers are declared unsupported and fail closed rather than returning a token that proves nothing.
productionOnly: limited-use token issuance and atomic consumption, which need a real App Check backend

surfaces.title: fireemu control API (sessions, clock, snapshots, faults)
surfaces.decision: A fireemu addition with no official counterpart. It is the surface the deterministic features are driven through and is never described as emulator parity.

claims.statement: The control API owns project-scoped sessions, the virtual clock, snapshots, fault plans and awaitIdle; it has no official counterpart and is versioned on its own terms.

fireemuOnly.behaviour: session isolation by project, in-memory named snapshots with an all-or-nothing capture and restore, seeded fault plans, and awaitIdle instead of sleeping

productionOnly: nothing: this surface is deliberately test-only and has no production form

surfaces.title: Emulator Suite UI
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: fireemu serves its own Emulator UI, but no capability manifest entry claims parity with the official UI's workflows and none is recorded in the conformance corpus.
gaps: the official UI's Firestore, Auth, Storage, Functions and Extensions workflows are not compared against any oracle
the official UI is a downloadable artifact (ui.main 1.15.0); fireemu embeds its own Solid application instead

surfaces.title: Emulator Hub
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: the discovery and orchestration API firebase-tools exposes on the hub port is not served.
gaps: the export trigger the CLI drives through the hub

surfaces.title: Emulator logging
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: the structured log stream the official UI consumes on the logging port is not served.
gaps: the EmulatorLog wire format on the logging port

surfaces.title: Cloud Pub/Sub
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: topic triggers are delivered through the control API, but the Pub/Sub wire emulator the official suite downloads is not served.
gaps: the Pub/Sub gRPC and REST surface on port 8085
publishing through a real Pub/Sub client rather than POST /v1/sessions/{s}/pubsub/topics/{t}:publish

surfaces.title: Eventarc
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: no Eventarc channel surface is served.
gaps: custom event channels and the CloudEvent publish route

surfaces.title: Cloud Tasks
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: no Cloud Tasks queue surface is served.
gaps: task queues, enqueue and dispatch to onTaskDispatched functions

surfaces.title: Firebase Data Connect
surfaces.decision: Active supported surface with an open gap: no Data Connect surface is served.
gaps: the GraphQL surface, the local PostgreSQL requirement and the generated SDKs

surfaces.title: Firebase Realtime Database
surfaces.decision: Deferred for low expected near-term demand (2026-08-30 scope policy). It stays in the pinned baseline, so no complete-suite or unqualified superset claim may be made while it is deferred.

surfaces.title: Firebase Hosting
surfaces.decision: Deferred for low expected near-term demand (2026-08-30 scope policy). It stays in the pinned baseline.

surfaces.title: Firebase App Hosting
surfaces.decision: Deferred for low expected near-term demand (2026-08-30 scope policy). It stays in the pinned baseline.

surfaces.title: Firebase Extensions
surfaces.decision: Not planned: managed Firebase Extensions is deprecated and scheduled to shut down on 2027-03-31, so the product decision is to never implement it. It stays in the pinned baseline, so no complete-suite claim may be made against this baseline at all.
